description: Search AITeamGuide's fully listed AI agents and AI receptionist products (public prices checked by AITeamGuide). Filter by free text, job category, free plan, or a maximum lowest listed monthly price in USD. Returns name, vendor, category, starting price, free plan flag, checked date and the AITeamGuide page.

free_only.description: Only products with a free plan or free tier.

max_monthly_usd.description: Only products whose lowest listed monthly price is at or below this many USD.

query.description: Words to match in the name, vendor or category, e.g. 'receptionist', 'coding', 'Cursor'.

name: search_ai_agents
title: Search AI agents by job, name or price
